channel.title: Astra Health – Physiotherapy Clinic
channel.description: Clinical excellence in physiotherapy, MSK assessment, women's health, and specialist treatments in Ashford, Kent.

item.title: What is Shockwave Therapy?
item.description: Shockwave therapy is a non-invasive treatment using high-intensity sound waves to stimulate tissue healing and reduce chronic musculoskeletal pain.

item.title: Understanding MSK Physiotherapy
item.description: Musculoskeletal (MSK) physiotherapy focuses on treating pain and dysfunction in muscles, joints, ligaments, and nerves. Learn how our specialists can help.

item.title: Women's Health Physiotherapy at Astra Health
item.description: Our specialist women's health physiotherapy services address pelvic floor dysfunction, pregnancy-related conditions, and post-natal recovery.

item.title: Meet Our Expert Clinical Team
item.description: Our award-winning clinical team brings years of specialist experience in physiotherapy, MSK assessment, and women's health treatment.
